verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY I’d only head out for Rey Cortiço after work (around 16:30) as a check-first kind of slot. Surfline looks poor-to-fair and it’s wind-exposed, so do your usual Surfline/MEO Beachcam check before you leave—if it doesn’t look clearly better than expected, I’d skip. The tide’s rising with a bit of push, which can help those punchier peaks at the sandbanks if you catch it right.
